query:
SELECT user_sessions.ip, COUNT(DISTINCT user_sessions.user_uuid) AS "users!", COUNT(*) AS "sessions!"
                        FROM user_sessions
                        WHERE user_sessions.last_used > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
                        GROUP BY user_sessions.ip
                        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_sessions.user_uuid) >= 2
                        ORDER BY 2 DESC
                        LIMIT 50
